questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The 'Your reserve price wasn't met' modal with 'Highest bid S$630', an 'Offer price' field and 'Offer at S$700 to all bidders' is unmistakable.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The teal 'Offer at S$700 to all bidders' button is the most prominent element in the modal.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: The button label states the price and who receives it, so it predicts the outcome exactly.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Highest bid', 'Bids 15 from 6 bidders' and 'Offer price' are the seller's own auction terms.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The seller sets a price knowing the highest bid and their own reserve, with 'Lower the price to improve your chances' as guidance.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Only highest bid, bid count and one field are shown.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: The modal sits on the seller's ended listing at the moment of decision.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: A deadline line, two stats and a field; the seller can act without reading paragraphs.
